_comment: Single home for matchmaker thresholds (Winfred, 21 Aug 2026). scoring.js keeps mirror literals for the browser; build.py FAILS the build if they drift from this file. Python (close_stale_prospects, apply_tenant_lifecycle via tenant_state, export_data) reads this file directly. dead_days and stale_days are the same rule seen from two sides (app block / db sweep) and must stay equal.
